tips.text: Use Blinding Dart on melee champions before they walk up to trade; a blinded enemy's attacks miss, so you take less damage.
Auto-attack the enemy between dart casts; Toxic Shot poisons them and keeps hurting after you step back.
Stand in a brush and stay still to turn invisible with Guerrilla Warfare, then attack for extra Attack Speed when you reveal yourself.
Place Noxious Trap in the brush and on the paths the enemy takes to reach you; anyone who steps on one is slowed and revealed.
Throw a Noxious Trap onto an existing mushroom to make it bounce further, which gives you more reach to set up a trap behind the enemy.
Use Move Quick to chase a slowed enemy or to escape a gank. Taking damage from champions or turrets turns off its passive speed for a while.
Clear a minion wave faster with Noxious Trap. Keep a charge or two for the enemy jungler.
Put mushrooms near Dragon and Baron to see when enemies come to take them.

combos.name: Mushroom bounce
combos.when: When you want a trap deeper into a lane, jungle entrance or objective than your throw range allows.
combos.text: A later-game combo with two charges: throw one mushroom, then throw a second onto it. The second bounces forward past the first and lands further away.

combos.name: Brush ambush
combos.when: When an enemy walks near the brush you are hiding in, for example the top lane river brush.
combos.text: Stay hidden in the brush, then attack as the enemy steps close. Leaving stealth gives bonus attack speed, so the first few hits come out much faster.

tips.text: Hit Aatrox with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; blinded, his attacks miss.
Use Blinding Dart from long range, then keep poking with Toxic Shot attacks. Aatrox has to walk into you to fight back.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms in the brush and on the path Aatrox takes to reach you. They slow him and show where he is.
Move sideways when Infernal Chains is coming at you, because it can only pull you back if you stay inside its circle. Move Quick helps you get out.
Stay out of the reach of The Darkin Blade's tip, because that is where it hits hardest. Hold your distance, since the hits are telegraphed.
Hit Akali with Blinding Dart when she comes in; the blind makes her basic attacks miss, which blunts her trade.
Drop Noxious Trap in the spots Akali dashes to or retreats through; she gets slowed and revealed when she steps on it.
Keep poking with Toxic Shot while she is low on energy, because she cannot trade back much then.
Stand in brush and stay invisible with Guerrilla Warfare so Akali has trouble picking her moment to start a fight.
Hit the Twilight Shroud area with Noxious Trap or Blinding Dart as she hides; a trap reveals her once she steps on it.
Once Akali has her ultimate at level 6, do not stand weakened; Perfect Execution finishes low-health targets, so back off to safety.
Hit Ambessa with Blinding Dart when she walks up to fight; blinded, her attacks miss, which blunts her trade.
Keep out of her reach and poke with Toxic Shot attacks; she has to close the gap and you can keep your distance.
Throw Noxious Trap in the paths she takes toward you, such as the lane brush; she is slowed and revealed when she steps on it.
Save Move Quick for when she locks onto you with Public Execution range in mind; its sprint helps you get away after a trade.
Do not stand in brush hoping to hide from her at level 6; she can blink to the farthest enemy champion in a line and suppress you.

comboRefs.note: Deep mushrooms slow Ambessa, whose dashes close the gap, so traps ahead of her punish her approach.

tips.text: Hit Anivia with Blinding Dart before she walks up to trade; blinded, her attacks miss, and her Frostbite and Flash Frost still land.
Stay out of a straight line from Anivia and sidestep Flash Frost. Getting hit leaves you slowed, and the stun comes when it bursts at its end.
Toss Noxious Trap behind you and in bushes as you retreat; Anivia has to chase through it and gets slowed.
Trade with Toxic Shot when her Flash Frost is on cooldown; the poison keeps ticking while you walk away.
Her egg from Rebirth is a window to push or trade freely, so do not chase it; kill her again once she hatches.
Use Move Quick to close in or run out of range when her Crystallize wall goes up.

comboRefs.note: Hiding in brush lets Teemo open with fast hits when Anivia walks close, since she has no listed way to see him.

tips.text: Hit Aurora with Blinding Dart when she walks up to trade; blinded, her basic attacks miss, so she can't win a short fight.
Aurora fights best up close, so keep attacking her from range with Toxic Shot and step back when she closes in.
Throw Noxious Trap where she will land after Across the Veil or in her escape path; it reveals her and slows her.
Don't stand still in the open waiting to turn invisible; Aurora's Twofold Hex reaches far and hits you from long range. Wait in a brush instead.
Place mushrooms around your lane and in the brush. When Aurora leaves her rift, a trap makes her slowed and revealed.
Hit Briar with Blinding Dart when she leaps in; blinded, her attacks miss, which blunts her trade.
Toss a Noxious Trap behind you or in the lane bush before she engages, so she is slowed and revealed when she chases.
Stay at long range and poke with Toxic Shot; Briar has no health regeneration of her own and must trade to heal.
Use Move Quick to run away once Briar locks onto you in Blood Frenzy; she is forced to chase and cannot choose another target.
Hit Camille with Blinding Dart when she walks up to trade; blinded, her attacks miss, so her Precision Protocol hits do little.
Keep poking her with Toxic Shot from long range and stay out of reach of her Tactical Sweep.
Plant Noxious Trap near walls and in brush where she likes to use Hookshot. Her dash then lands her in a slow.
Hold Blinding Dart for her Hookshot dash in. If she is blinded, her follow-up attacks miss.
Use Move Quick to run away when she dives onto you. Her Hextech Ultimatum traps you in a zone, so stay far from her once she has level 6.
Hit Cho'Gath with Blinding Dart before he walks up to trade; his attacks miss while he is blinded.
Stay at long range and poke with Toxic Shot attacks. Cho'Gath has to walk into your range to trade.
Stand away from where Rupture is aimed. Its ground warning shows where it lands, so step out of it.
Keep your distance from Cho'Gath; Feral Scream is short range and silences you if you are caught in the cone.
Place Noxious Trap in the lane bushes and behind you. Cho'Gath will be slowed when he steps on one and chases you.
Take damage from Cho'Gath and Move Quick stops working for a while. Avoid his hits to keep your speed.
Poke Darius with Blinding Dart whenever you can. It has more range than your attacks, and the blind makes his basic attacks miss.
Keep Darius out of reach. He wants to get close, so hit him from range and back away before he can reach you.
Throw a Noxious Trap at your feet or in the brush he walks toward. He gets slowed and revealed, so he can't close the gap easily.
Use Move Quick to walk away when his Apprehend is on cooldown, and to run if he gets close. You only get the speed boost while he isn't hitting you.
Stay out of Apprehend's cone. Once he pulls you in, you are knocked up and can't get away from him.
Don't fight Darius when he has many bleed stacks on you. Back off, since Noxian Guillotine hurts more the more stacks he has.
Poke Dr. Mundo with Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot while he walks up; he has no way to close the gap except by being close, so stay at range.
Stay out of line with Infected Bonesaw. It hurts more the more Health you have, and it slows you.
Put Noxious Trap in the paths Dr. Mundo walks to reach you; he is slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Do not rely on trapping him in place. Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect that hits him.
Do not stand beside him while Heart Zapper charges. It hurts nearby enemies and heals him when he recasts it.
Use Move Quick to walk away when he commits. Do not trade for long, because Maximum Dosage lets him heal through your damage.

comboRefs.note: Brush ambush gets fast first hits on Mundo, who has no listed way to hit a hidden target.

tips.text: Fire Blinding Dart at Fiora when she walks up to trade; blinded, her attacks miss, and her Vital hits can fail too.
Do not use Blinding Dart on her while Riposte is ready; she parries it and you waste your best tool.
Poke her with Toxic Shot attacks from long range, and back off once she lunges in.
Place Noxious Trap behind you and in bushes where she will lunge or chase; she gets slowed and revealed.
Her Grand Challenge makes her faster near you, so use Move Quick early to run away and keep your distance.
Hit Gangplank with Blinding Dart when he walks up to last-hit; his Parrrley attacks can miss while he is blinded.
Toss Noxious Trap into the bushes and onto his path. He is slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Keep poking him with Toxic Shot from long range, and back off before he can close in on you.
Don't expect to hold him with slows. Remove Scurvy clears them, so Noxious Trap won't pin him down while it is ready.
Hit his Powder Keg with a basic attack to defuse it. An enemy who destroys a keg defuses it safely.

comboRefs.note: Gangplank is melee, so he must step close to the brush where Teemo's hidden attack-speed burst hits first.

tips.text: Hit Garen with Blinding Dart before he gets close; a blinded Garen misses his attacks and cannot trade well.
Stay at long range and auto attack him so Toxic Shot keeps ticking; Garen has no ranged way to reach you.
Hit him with Toxic Shot to stop his Perseverance healing; keep poking him so he cannot regenerate.
Throw Noxious Trap in the path he walks to you; it slows him, and the slow is removed only if he uses Decisive Strike.
Use Move Quick to run away when Garen's Decisive Strike is spent or when he is low enough to threaten Demacian Justice.
Hide in brush to turn invisible with Guerrilla Warfare and ambush him with extra attack speed when he walks up.
Throw Blinding Dart at Gnar before he walks up to trade; his attacks miss while he is blinded, and he is mini and wants to poke you.
Stay out of Gnar's Boomerang Throw line, and keep your distance until you want to fight; he outranges you in mini form.
Hide mushrooms from Noxious Trap near walls and in brush that Gnar must walk through; he is slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Keep trading with Toxic Shot while Gnar is mini; the poison keeps ticking after he backs away.
Fight Gnar when he has just turned back from Mega; he cannot gain Rage for a while.
Do not stand near a wall when Gnar is Mega; GNAR! throws you into it and stuns you.
Hit Gragas with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; blinded, his attacks miss and Drunken Rage's empowered hit is wasted.
Stay at long range and poke with Toxic Shot attacks; the poison keeps hurting Gragas after you step back.
Keep Noxious Trap mushrooms behind you and in the brush. When Gragas jumps in with Body Slam, he can land on one and get slowed.
Do not stand where Gragas can hit you with Body Slam; the stun lets him and his Barrel Roll burst you down.
Step out of the area where Barrel Roll comes to rest before it blows up; the longer it sits, the more it hurts and slows.
Hit Gwen with Blinding Dart when she walks up to trade; blinded, her attacks miss, which blunts her Snip Snip! stacks and empowered attacks.
Poke her with Toxic Shot from range and stay out of her reach. She needs to attack a few times to set up her damage.
Do not waste damage on Gwen while Hallowed Mist is up; she cannot be targeted from outside it. Back off and wait for it to end.
Put Noxious Trap where she dashes in or stands to fight; it slows her and shows where she is.
Use Move Quick to step away after Gwen uses Skip 'n Slash; her empowered attacks hit hard and reach further for a short time.
Sidestep between Needlework casts; she must hit something to recast, and the later casts hurt most.
Hit Heimerdinger with Blinding Dart before he trades; it blinds him so his attacks miss, and it outranges his basic attacks.
Stay out of range of his grenade; if it stuns you, his turrets charge up and you take heavy damage.
Hide in brush with Guerrilla Warfare and wait for him to walk forward, then attack with Toxic Shot to poison him.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms around his turrets and in the lane's brush. He is slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Don't stand beside his turrets. Fight him away from them, or push the wave and make him come to you.

comboRefs.note: Brush ambush gives fast first hits, but Heimerdinger's turrets and grenade punish Teemo once he is revealed.

tips.text: Poke with Toxic Shot attacks and Blinding Dart from range, and stay out of Illaoi's reach. She wants to get close, and your poison wears her down first.
Use Blinding Dart on Illaoi when she walks up to attack. A blinded enemy misses their basic attacks.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms in the paths she uses to approach. They leave her slowed and make it harder for her to reach you.
Use Move Quick to walk away when she leaps in with Harsh Lesson. Her Tentacles only hit while she is close.
Hit the Tentacles Illaoi creates. The Tentacles are what make her strong, so killing them weakens her fights.
Stay away from the Spirit that Test of Spirit pulls out of you. Fight back or walk away so the Tentacles can't hit you.

comboRefs.note: Illaoi's Tentacles spawn on terrain, but Teemo's brush ambush gets fast first hits as she walks close.

tips.text: Use Blinding Dart on Irelia when she wants to trade; she is blinded and her basic attacks miss, and her Bladesurge still lands.
Throw Noxious Trap where Irelia walks to trade or farm; she is slowed and revealed, and she cannot dash in through the slow so easily.
Hit Irelia with Toxic Shot from long range and back off. She has to run through minions to reach you.
Do not fight while Irelia is charging Defiant Dance; it cuts your damage and crowd control cannot stop it. Wait for it to end, then trade.
Stay out of the line between Flawless Duet's blades; you get stunned. Step sideways when she throws the first blade.
Hide in brush and stand still to turn invisible with Guerrilla Warfare, then ambush Irelia when she steps up for minions.
Use Blinding Dart on Jax when he leaps in or tries to trade; his basic attacks miss while he is blinded, which cuts his damage.
Poke Jax from range with Toxic Shot attacks and back off before he can leap onto you.
Don't attack Jax while Counter Strike is up; he dodges your attacks and then stuns you. Wait for it to end, then hit him.
Throw Noxious Trap mushrooms behind you and in the brush on your side of the lane. Jax slowed by one is easier to kite.
Jax can leap to wards, so place mushrooms near any ward he has. A leap that lands on a trap sets it off.
Avoid long fights once Jax has built up his attack speed; fight in short bursts and use Move Quick to leave.
Hit Jayce with Blinding Dart when he swings in melee; a blind makes his basic attacks miss, so his trades are weaker.
Stay at the edge of Blinding Dart range and poison him with Toxic Shot while he is in Cannon Stance.
Drop Noxious Trap where Jayce will land or chase you. He is slowed and revealed when he steps on it.
Stand in brush with Guerrilla Warfare, then poison him when he walks up to last-hit.
After To the Skies! lands on you, run with Move Quick, since Jayce is slowed and can't follow up fast.

comboRefs.note: Hiding in brush keeps Teemo invisible, so Jayce's leap and swaps have no target until Teemo attacks.

tips.text: Keep Blinding Dart for when K'Sante walks up to trade; his attacks then miss for a while, so his trade falls apart.
Stay at long range and poison him with Toxic Shot while he is walking up. He has no ranged way to reach you except Ntofo Strikes.
Throw Noxious Trap in the brush and on his usual approach paths. He is slowed and revealed when he steps on one, so you can kite him.
Don't stand in line with K'Sante when his Ntofo Strikes has two stacks. The second hit pulls you in and stuns you.
Stay away from walls when K'Sante has All Out ready. He can pull you through terrain and hit you again.
Use Move Quick to walk away from Path Maker's dash. A long charge makes the stun longer, so move away when he starts charging.
Hit Kayle with Toxic Shot while she is still melee, before level 6. She cannot reach you easily and you win trades.
Use Blinding Dart when Kayle runs up to trade, so her attacks miss and her early game is wasted.
Place Noxious Trap on the paths Kayle takes to the lane, so she is slowed when she approaches.
Dodge Radiant Blast by standing out of line, or keep a minion between you; it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Be wary of Kayle after level 6. Her range grows and Divine Ascent makes her attacks strong, so stay away from her unless you can hit her first.
Hit Kennen with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; his basic attacks miss while he is blinded, so his empowered attack is wasted.
Stay at long range and poke with Toxic Shot attacks. Kennen has to take risks to reach you.
Throw Noxious Trap mushrooms in the bushes and on the paths Kennen walks. A trap slows him and reveals him.
Stay out of the range of Thundering Shuriken. Once Kennen has marks on you, back away, because the third hit stuns you.
Use Move Quick to run away when Kennen dashes in with Lightning Rush. Hit him with a dart afterward.
Hit Kled with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; blinded, his attacks miss, so his Violent Tendencies burst does little.
Stay at long range and poke with Toxic Shot attacks. Kled has to close the gap, so back away as he comes.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms in the lane bushes and on his approach path. A slowed Kled is easier to kite.
Stand out of range of Bear Trap on a Rope. If it hooks you, walk away from Kled before he pulls you in.
Once Kled is dismounted, he is weaker and loses his abilities, so push the fight and punish him.
Hit Malphite with Blinding Dart before he trades; his Attacks miss while he is blinded, so his Thunderclap empowered hit is wasted.
Poke with Toxic Shot attacks from long range. Malphite has to walk up to you, and Seismic Shard is his only ranged tool.
Throw Noxious Trap behind you and on your escape path. Malphite is slowed and revealed when he steps on one while chasing you.
Stay out of his range once he reaches level 6. Unstoppable Force can't be stopped by crowd control and knocks you up.
Stand in brush and stay still so Guerrilla Warfare hides you. Attack when he steps close to get the extra Attack Speed.
Hit Mordekaiser with Blinding Dart before he walks up to trade; blinded, his basic attacks miss, which also slows how fast his Darkness Rise builds.
Keep your distance and poke with Toxic Shot attacks. Back away before he reaches you, because his damage aura only hurts enemies close to him.
Stay out of a straight line from him, because Death's Grasp pulls you in. Step sideways once you see the claw appear.
Put Noxious Trap mushrooms in the brush and on the path he walks. He gets slowed and revealed, which gives you time to retreat.
Hold Move Quick for when he pulls you in or closes on you. The sprint keeps its speed while you are hit.
Don't spend your whole fight hitting his Indestructible shield. Wait for it to fade, or poke when it is down.
Hit Naafiri with Blinding Dart when she commits to a fight; the blind makes her basic attacks miss, which blunts her trades.
Keep your distance and auto her with Toxic Shot; she has to run into you to trade, and the poison keeps ticking when she backs off.
Hide Noxious Trap mushrooms behind you and in the brush she walks through; she gets slowed and revealed when she steps on one.
Her Packmates will chase you, so fight when the enemy is alone and has few packmates around.
Use Move Quick to run away when she dashes onto you with Hounds' Pursuit, and stay out of damage so the speed boost stays on.
Hit Nasus with Blinding Dart when he walks up to last-hit; blinded, his Siphoning Strike attack misses.
Poke him with Toxic Shot attacks from long range and keep walking away so he cannot reach you.
Toss Noxious Trap on the path he walks to you; he is slowed and cannot catch you easily.
Stay out of Wither range. If it lands, you are slowed hard and your attacks come slowly.
Do not fight Nasus while Fury of the Sands is active; run and let the cooldown tick.
Use Move Quick to run away after a trade; it keeps its speed even if you are hit.
Poke Olaf with Blinding Dart and your poison from range, and do not let him reach you. He is stronger the closer he gets.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms where Olaf walks to the lane, so the slow punishes his approach.
Stay clear of Undertow's line and keep minions between you; it slows and cuts your Armor.
Do not rely on slows or stuns once Ragnarok starts; Olaf shrugs them off. Back away from him and let it run out.
Hit Ornn with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade or last-hit; blinded, his basic attacks miss.
Stay out of reach of Ornn's Searing Charge by fighting away from walls; he needs terrain to knock you up.
Hide in brush with Guerrilla Warfare and attack from it. Ornn has no way to see you coming.
Plant Noxious Trap in the paths Ornn walks to the wave and behind your own wave. He is slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Poke him with Toxic Shot attacks from range, since Ornn has no long ranged attack to answer except Volcanic Rupture.
Sidestep Volcanic Rupture. Getting hit slows you and sets up the rest of his combo.
Hit Pantheon with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; his attacks will miss while he is blinded.
Keep poking him with Toxic Shot from long range and don't let him close the gap for free.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms behind you and near the bush. When Pantheon leaps in, he will be slowed and revealed.
Move away from Pantheon when his Shield Vault is ready, because it will stun you. Don't stand where he can easily reach you.
Don't attack Pantheon from the front while he braces with Aegis Assault. Wait it out or hit him from the side.
Stay healthy: a thrown Comet Spear hits much harder when you are low. Use Move Quick to get away from him.
Hit Quinn with Blinding Dart when she goes for a trade; her attacks miss while she is blinded, which blunts her damage.
Stay at range and poke her with Toxic Shot; she has to cross a lot of ground to reach you.
Drop Noxious Trap behind you or in the brush she likes to come from; she gets slowed and revealed when she steps on it.
Watch for Quinn's Vault: it dashes onto you and bounces her back out, so don't chase her after it.
When her Behind Enemy Lines channel starts, she is about to roam. Push the wave, then place mushrooms in the lanes she would use to get to you.
Blind Renekton with Blinding Dart before he trades. His attacks then miss, so Ruthless Predator does little.
Stay at long range and keep attacking with Toxic Shot. Renekton has to dash in to reach you, and the poison keeps hurting him when he backs out.
Put Noxious Trap mushrooms in the bushes and along the path Renekton walks to you. He gets slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Be ready when Renekton's Fury is high. The empowered Ruthless Predator stuns for much longer, so keep your distance and don't let him reach you.
Use Move Quick to run away after Renekton dashes in. It only gives its full speed if you haven't been hit recently.
Hit Riven with Blinding Dart when she walks up to trade; blinded, her attacks miss, so her all-in loses most of its damage.
Keep your distance and trade with Toxic Shot attacks; Riven has to dash in to reach you, so poke her whenever she steps forward.
Throw Noxious Trap behind you and at the sides of your lane position; Riven is slowed and revealed if she dashes onto one.
Riven's Ki Burst stuns at close range, so don't let her stand next to you. Use Move Quick to walk away when she is on cooldown.
Move Quick's speed boost is lost when she damages you, so use the active to run when she is already on you.

comboRefs.note: Riven has no listed stealth reveal, so a brush ambush can open a fast attack-speed trade on her.

tips.text: Hit Rumble with Blinding Dart before he walks up to trade, so his attacks miss while you poison him.
Keep auto-attacking from range so Toxic Shot keeps ticking on Rumble. Back off once he closes in with Flamespitter.
Put Noxious Trap in the bush and on the paths Rumble uses to reach you. He gets slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Look for the moment Rumble overheats. He can't cast spells then, so poke him freely, but stay away from his hard-hitting attacks.
Rumble's Electro Harpoon slows you. Use Move Quick to get away and out of range of his next one.
Hit Sett with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; blinded, his punches miss, so his Knuckle Down bonus damage is wasted.
Stay at long range and poke with Toxic Shot. Sett has to walk into you, and he is slowed less when he cannot reach you.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms in the lane behind you and on his approach path. Sett is slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Stay out of Facebreaker range. If he pulls you from both sides with minions, you are stunned.
Do not trade into his Haymaker when he has taken lots of damage. It turns that damage into a shield and a strong punch.
Use Move Quick to escape when he commits. Take no damage and you keep the passive speed.
Poke Shen with Blinding Dart when he walks up to last-hit; his attacks miss while he is blinded, which weakens his trades.
Stay out of Shadow Dash range, because getting taunted lets Shen hit you with attacks. Teemo has little health to spare.
Put Noxious Trap in the brush and along Shen's path. He gets slowed and revealed, which makes it easy to hit him.
Trade with Toxic Shot attacks from range. Back off when Shen's Twilight Assault empowers his next attacks, since they hit hard.
Hit Singed with Blinding Dart before he walks up to Fling you; a blinded enemy misses basic attacks, so he trades poorly.
Poke Singed with Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot from long range, and stay out of his Poison Trail.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms in the lane behind you and in nearby brush. Singed chasing you will slow himself on them.
Use Move Quick to run away when Singed runs at you. Mega Adhesive slows you, so stay out of its area.
Do not stand close to Singed when he has Mega Adhesive ready. Fling into it leaves you rooted.
Stay out of Sion's range while he charges Decimating Smash; if you see him start, step to the side or back away before it releases.
Put Blinding Dart on Sion and keep poking with attacks; Toxic Shot punishes him when he must walk up.
Place Noxious Trap mushrooms behind you and in the lane's bushes so Sion gets slowed when he chases.
Use Move Quick to escape after Sion's Roar of the Slayer slows you, and avoid fighting when he is shielded.
Do not kill Sion carelessly in a fight; he comes back with Glory in Death and hits very fast, so back away until it ends.
Hit Tahm Kench with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; blinded, his attacks miss and he can't trade well.
Stay out of Tongue Lash range and keep minions out of its path, since it hits the first enemy in its line.
Poke with Toxic Shot attacks, then step back before he gets three stacks of An Acquired Taste on you.
Plant Noxious Trap in the brush and along his path; he gets slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Move away from the spot he targets when you see Abyssal Dive start, since it knocks up and stuns everyone there.
Hit him with Toxic Shot during Thick Skin's shield window; the shield only lasts a short time, so poke again afterward.
Hit Tryndamere with Blinding Dart before he walks up to trade; his basic attacks will miss while he is blinded, so he gains less Fury.
Poke him with Toxic Shot attacks early and often. If he can't last-hit minions, he can't build Fury to heal.
Throw Noxious Trap mushrooms in the path he dashes along and behind you. They slow him and reveal him if he steps on one.
Keep Move Quick ready for when he dives in. Running away from him also leaves you open to Mocking Shout's slow, so don't rely on running alone.
Don't chase him when he gets low. Undying Rage keeps him alive, so wait for it to end before you commit.

comboRefs.note: Faster first hits from the brush ambush help against Tryndamere, who is a melee champion that must walk up to you.

tips.text: Hit Urgot with Blinding Dart when he walks up; it stops his basic attacks, so Echoing Flames can't fire.
Stay at long range and poke him with Toxic Shot. He has to walk into you, and Corrosive Charge is easy to dodge when you move.
Play back from Disdain; it stuns and throws you when it connects. Place Noxious Trap mushrooms behind you so a chasing Urgot steps on them.
Once Urgot is low, run away from him fast; Fear Beyond Death can pull you in. Stay above the low-health line while the drill is on you.
Hit Varus with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; blinded, his attacks miss and Blighted Quiver stacks stop building.
Stay out of the long reach of Piercing Arrow and step sideways while he charges it; it is a narrow line.
Hide in brush and wait; Guerrilla Warfare lets you move unseen there, so you can step out and trade with Toxic Shot.
Drop Noxious Trap behind you when you retreat from Varus; the trap slows him if he chases.
Keep your Move Quick speed by avoiding damage, so you can dodge Hail of Arrows and walk away from his poke.
Be careful at level 6; if Chain of Corruption lands, you are rooted and cannot trade back. Stay far from his line of fire.

comboRefs.note: Hidden in brush, Teemo's faster first hits can punish Varus walking close, as Varus is a ranged champion.

tips.text: Hit Vayne with Blinding Dart when she walks up to attack; she is blinded and her attacks miss for a while.
Use Blinding Dart on her before she trades, since her best damage comes from her attacks.
Throw Noxious Trap near walls and in brush at your side of the lane; she is slowed and revealed when she steps on one.
Stand with your back away from walls when she has Condemn ready; a wall hit stuns you and hurts a lot.
Poke her with Toxic Shot attacks from range, because she is fragile and hates being worn down.
Hit Vladimir with Blinding Dart before he reaches you; a blinded Vladimir misses his basic attacks.
Stay at range and poke with Toxic Shot; Vladimir's Transfusion heals him, so a quick trade costs you.
Put Noxious Trap on the paths Vladimir walks to catch him; he is slowed and revealed.
Don't chase while Vladimir is in Sanguine Pool; he can't be targeted and it hurts and slows you if you stay near.
Use Move Quick to get out of Hemoplague range and away from his burst.
Hit Volibear with Blinding Dart when he runs at you; a blinded Volibear misses his basic attacks, though Frenzied Maul still lands.
Keep your distance and auto him with Toxic Shot. He has no ranged poke, so he must walk up to you.
Toss Noxious Trap in front of you on his approach path. Getting slowed makes it harder for him to close the gap.
Do not let him reach you when Thundering Smash is ready, because it stuns on hit. Back away when he gets close and he fast-closes the gap.
Stand in the brush and wait unseen. Hit him with Blinding Dart as he walks past to start a trade.
Step away from the spot where Sky Splitter is landing; it is slow to fall and hurts big.
Hit Xin Zhao with Blinding Dart as he runs in. His attacks miss, so his trade is much weaker.
Poke with Toxic Shot and back off. Xin Zhao has to chase you, and the poison keeps hurting him.
Put Noxious Trap mushrooms behind you and in nearby brush. Xin Zhao's charge and chase run you into them, and they slow him.
Don't stand close to Xin Zhao. Audacious Charge closes the gap fast, and Three Talon Strike's third attack knocks you up.
Use Move Quick to get away once Xin Zhao commits. It also lets you kite him between your attacks.
Hit Yasuo with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; his attacks miss while he is blinded, which blunts his all-in.
Don't send Blinding Dart into a Wind Wall; it blocks projectiles. Wait for the wall to fade, then throw it.
Place Noxious Trap in the brush and on the path Yasuo walks to farm. He gets slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Keep poking with Toxic Shot attacks from max range. Yasuo has to dash in through minions to reach you.
Stay out of Steel Tempest's line when it has two stacks, because the whirlwind knocks you up. Step sideways when you see it.
Hit Yone with Blinding Dart when he walks up to trade; the blind makes his attacks miss, so his fight is much weaker.
Keep poking with Toxic Shot attacks from range and back off before Yone can reach you.
Put Noxious Trap in the brush and on the path Yone takes to reach you; he is slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Stay away from Yone once he has used Fate Sealed or when his Mortal Steel stacks are ready; a knock up plus the pull can kill you.
Use Move Quick to run away when Yone dashes in with Soul Unbound.

comboRefs.note: Hiding in brush lets Teemo open with fast hits on Yone if he walks close, before Yone's dashes.

tips.text: Hit Yorick with Blinding Dart when he walks up to hit you; a blinded enemy misses their basic attacks, which blunts his Last Rites.
Poke him with Toxic Shot attacks from range and walk away; his Mourning Mist slows only briefly, so keep your distance.
Throw Noxious Trap behind your own position and on the paths he takes to reach you; he gets slowed and revealed when he steps on one.
Stay out of his Dark Procession ring; walls trap you inside, so walk away or break it with basic attacks.
Kill Mist Walkers quickly with basic attacks so Yorick has fewer helpers, and watch for the Maiden of the Mist at level 6.
Use Blinding Dart on Zaahen when he walks up to trade; a blinded Zaahen can't land his attacks, including the empowered one from The Darkin Glaive.
Poke him with Toxic Shot attacks from a safe range. Zaahen has to cross the gap to fight, and the poison keeps ticking while he does.
Throw Noxious Trap on the path Zaahen takes to reach you, or in the brush he walks through. A trap slows him and shows where he is.
Zaahen's Dreaded Return is a line shot, so stay out of its line. Use Move Quick to speed away after a trade.
Back off once Cultivation of War has stacked up from hitting you; he hits much harder when it fills. Don't let long trades feed him.
